CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS avatar_catalog (
  avatar_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  avatar TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  avatar_short TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  avatar_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'influencer',
  description TEXT NULL,
  notes TEXT NULL,
  is_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  disabled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL,
  disabled_reason TEXT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scene_catalog (
  scene_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  scene TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NULL,
  notes TEXT NULL,

  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS asset_type_catalog (
  asset_type_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  asset_type TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NULL,
  notes TEXT NULL,
  is_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  disabled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL,
  disabled_reason TEXT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS generation_workflow_catalog (
  generation_workflow_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  workflow TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,

);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS generation_model_catalog (
  generation_model_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  model TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  provider TEXT NULL,
  description TEXT NULL,
  notes TEXT NULL,
  is_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  disabled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL,
  disabled_reason TEXT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ingest_profiles (
  profile_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  profile_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  avatar TEXT NOT NULL,
  avatar_short TEXT NOT NULL,
  scene TEXT NOT NULL,
  asset_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  workflow TEXT NOT NULL,
  model TEXT NOT NULL,
  seed BIGINT NULL,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  auto_promote_latest BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  is_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  disabled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL,
  disabled_reason TEXT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (avatar, scene, asset_type, workflow, model, version)
);

-- Existing table compatibility.
ALTER TABLE ingest_profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true;
ALTER TABLE ingest_profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS disabled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL;
ALTER TABLE ingest_profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS disabled_reason TEXT NULL;

UPDATE ingest_profiles
SET is_enabled = true
WHERE is_enabled IS NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_avatar_catalog_enabled ON avatar_catalog (is_enabled, avatar);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_scene_catalog_enabled ON scene_catalog (is_enabled, scene);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_asset_type_catalog_enabled ON asset_type_catalog (is_enabled, asset_type);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_generation_workflow_catalog_enabled ON generation_workflow_catalog (is_enabled, workflow);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_generation_model_catalog_enabled ON generation_model_catalog (is_enabled, model);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ingest_profiles_active ON ingest_profiles (is_active, is_enabled);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ingest_profiles_avatar_scene ON ingest_profiles (avatar, scene, asset_type);

-- Normalize existing active profiles before unique index.
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    profile_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        CASE
          WHEN avatar = 'estefania-montealegre'
           AND scene = 'coffee-rain'
           AND asset_type = 'raw-image'
           AND workflow = 'flux-krea-dev'
           AND model = 'flux-krea-dev'
          THEN 0 ELSE 1
        END,
        updated_at DESC,
        created_at DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM ingest_profiles
  WHERE is_active = true
)
UPDATE ingest_profiles p
SET
  is_active = CASE WHEN r.rn = 1 THEN true ELSE false END,
  updated_at = now()
FROM ranked r
WHERE p.profile_id = r.profile_id;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_ingest_profiles_single_active
  ON ingest_profiles ((is_active))
  WHERE is_active = true;

SELECT
  asset_id,
  avatar,
  asset_type,
  scene,
  bucket,
  object_path,
  mime_type,
  status,
  sha256,
  created_at,
  CONCAT(avatar, ':', scene, ':', asset_type) AS target_canonical_group
FROM canonical_asset_registry
WHERE asset_id = '{{ $("Normalize Promote Request").first().json.assetId }}'
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE canonical_asset_registry
SET
  is_canonical = false,
  status = 'selected',
  metadata = jsonb_set(
    jsonb_set(
      metadata,
      '{status}',
      '"selected"'
    ),
    '{isCanonical}',
    'false'
  )
WHERE canonical_group = '{{ $("Get Target Asset").first().json.target_canonical_group }}'
  AND is_canonical = true
  AND asset_id <> '{{ $("Get Target Asset").first().json.asset_id }}';

UPDATE canonical_asset_registry
SET
  is_canonical = true,
  status = 'canonical',
  canonical_group = '{{ $("Get Target Asset").first().json.target_canonical_group }}',
  review_notes = '{{ $("Normalize Promote Request").first().json.reviewNotes }}',
  metadata = jsonb_set(
    jsonb_set(
      jsonb_set(
        jsonb_set(
          metadata,
          '{status}',
          '"canonical"'
        ),
        '{isCanonical}',
        'true'
      ),
      '{reviewNotes}',
      '"{{ $("Normalize Promote Request").first().json.reviewNotes }}"'
    ),
    '{canonicalGroup}',
    '"{{ $("Get Target Asset").first().json.target_canonical_group }}"'
  )
WHERE asset_id = '{{ $("Get Target Asset").first().json.asset_id }}'
RETURNING
  asset_id,
  avatar,
  asset_type,
  scene,
  bucket,
  object_path,
  mime_type,
  status,
  sha256,
  canonical_group,
  review_notes,

name: Avatares AI - Admin - Upsert Ingest Profile

parameters.jsCode:
function sql(value) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') return 'NULL';
  return `'${String(value).replace(/'/g, "''")}'`;
}

function bool(value) {
  return value === true || value === 'true' ? 'true' : 'false';
}

const body = $json.body || {};

const profileName = body.profileName || `${body.avatar || 'estefania-montealegre'} / ${body.scene || 'coffee-rain'} / ${body.assetType || 'raw-image'}`;
const avatar = body.avatar || 'estefania-montealegre';
const avatarShort = body.avatarShort || body.avatar_short || 'estefania';
const scene = body.scene || 'coffee-rain';
const assetType = body.assetType || body.asset_type || 'raw-image';
const workflow = body.workflow || 'flux-krea-dev';
const model = body.model || 'flux-krea-dev';
const seed = body.seed === undefined || body.seed === null || body.seed === '' ? 'NULL' : Number(body.seed);
const version = body.version === undefined || body.version === null || body.version === '' ? 1 : Number(body.version);
const autoPromoteLatest = bool(body.autoPromoteLatest ?? body.auto_promote_latest ?? false);
const setActive = body.setActive === true || body.isActive === true;

let query = `
WITH upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO ingest_profiles (
    profile_name,
    avatar,
    avatar_short,
    scene,
    asset_type,
    workflow,
    model,
    seed,
    version,
    auto_promote_latest,
    is_active,
    is_enabled
  )
  VALUES (
    ${sql(profileName)},
    ${sql(avatar)},
    ${sql(avatarShort)},
    ${sql(scene)},
    ${sql(assetType)},
    ${sql(workflow)},
    ${sql(model)},
    ${seed},
    ${version},
    ${autoPromoteLatest},
    false,
    true
  )
  ON CONFLICT (avatar, scene, asset_type, workflow, model, version)
  DO UPDATE SET
    profile_name = EXCLUDED.profile_name,
    avatar_short = EXCLUDED.avatar_short,
    seed = EXCLUDED.seed,
    auto_promote_latest = EXCLUDED.auto_promote_latest,
    is_enabled = true,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING *
)
`;

if (setActive) {
  query += `,
deactivated AS (
  UPDATE ingest_profiles
  SET is_active = false, updated_at = now()
  WHERE is_active = true
  RETURNING profile_id
),
activated AS (
  UPDATE ingest_profiles p
  SET is_active = true, updated_at = now()
  FROM upserted u
  WHERE p.profile_id = u.profile_id
  RETURNING p.*
)
SELECT
  profile_id AS "profileId",
  profile_name AS "profileName",
  avatar,
  avatar_short AS "avatarShort",
  scene,
  asset_type AS "assetType",
  workflow,
  model,
  seed,
  version,
  auto_promote_latest AS "autoPromoteLatest",
  is_active AS "isActive",
  is_enabled AS "isEnabled",
  created_at AS "createdAt",
  updated_at AS "updatedAt"
FROM activated;`;
} else {
  query += `SELECT
  profile_id AS "profileId",
  profile_name AS "profileName",
  avatar,
  avatar_short AS "avatarShort",
  scene,
  asset_type AS "assetType",
  workflow,
  model,
  seed,
  version,
  auto_promote_latest AS "autoPromoteLatest",
  is_active AS "isActive",
  is_enabled AS "isEnabled",
  created_at AS "createdAt",
  updated_at AS "updatedAt"
FROM upserted;`;
}

return { json: { query } };

name: Avatares AI - Admin - Upsert Ingest Profile Catalog Validated

parameters.jsCode:
function sql(value) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') return 'NULL';
  return `'${String(value).replace(/'/g, "''")}'`;
}

function bool(value) {
  return value === true || value === 'true' ? 'true' : 'false';
}

const body = $json.body || {};

const profileName = body.profileName || `${body.avatar || 'estefania-montealegre'} / ${body.scene || 'coffee-rain'} / ${body.assetType || 'raw-image'}`;
const avatar = body.avatar || 'estefania-montealegre';
const avatarShort = body.avatarShort || body.avatar_short || 'estefania';
const scene = body.scene || 'coffee-rain';
const assetType = body.assetType || body.asset_type || 'raw-image';
const workflow = body.workflow || 'flux-krea-dev';
const model = body.model || 'flux-krea-dev';
const seed = body.seed === undefined || body.seed === null || body.seed === '' ? 'NULL' : Number(body.seed);
const version = body.version === undefined || body.version === null || body.version === '' ? 1 : Number(body.version);
const autoPromoteLatest = bool(body.autoPromoteLatest ?? body.auto_promote_latest ?? false);
const isEnabled = body.isEnabled === false || body.is_enabled === false ? false : true;
const setActive = body.setActive === true || body.isActive === true;

const query = `
WITH validation AS (
  SELECT
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM avatar_catalog WHERE avatar = ${sql(avatar)} AND is_enabled = true) AS avatar_ok,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scene_catalog WHERE scene = ${sql(scene)} AND is_enabled = true) AS scene_ok,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM asset_type_catalog WHERE asset_type = ${sql(assetType)} AND is_enabled = true) AS asset_type_ok,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generation_workflow_catalog WHERE workflow = ${sql(workflow)} AND is_enabled = true) AS workflow_ok,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generation_model_catalog WHERE model = ${sql(model)} AND is_enabled = true) AS model_ok
),
validated AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN NOT avatar_ok THEN 'Invalid or disabled avatar'
      WHEN NOT scene_ok THEN 'Invalid or disabled scene'
      WHEN NOT asset_type_ok THEN 'Invalid or disabled asset type'
      WHEN NOT workflow_ok THEN 'Invalid or disabled workflow'
      WHEN NOT model_ok THEN 'Invalid or disabled model'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS error_message
  FROM validation
),
upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO ingest_profiles (
    profile_name,
    avatar,
    avatar_short,
    scene,
    asset_type,
    workflow,
    model,
    seed,
    version,
    auto_promote_latest,
    is_active,
    is_enabled
  )
  SELECT
    ${sql(profileName)},
    ${sql(avatar)},
    ${sql(avatarShort)},
    ${sql(scene)},
    ${sql(assetType)},
    ${sql(workflow)},
    ${sql(model)},
    ${seed},
    ${version},
    ${autoPromoteLatest},
    false,
    ${isEnabled ? 'true' : 'false'}
  FROM validated
  WHERE error_message IS NULL
  ON CONFLICT (avatar, scene, asset_type, workflow, model, version)
  DO UPDATE SET
    profile_name = EXCLUDED.profile_name,
    avatar_short = EXCLUDED.avatar_short,
    seed = EXCLUDED.seed,
    auto_promote_latest = EXCLUDED.auto_promote_latest,
    is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled,
    disabled_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.is_enabled THEN NULL ELSE ingest_profiles.disabled_at END,
    disabled_reason = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.is_enabled THEN NULL ELSE ingest_profiles.disabled_reason END,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING *
),
deactivated AS (
  UPDATE ingest_profiles
  SET is_active = false, updated_at = now()
  WHERE ${setActive ? 'true' : 'false'} AND is_active = true
  RETURNING profile_id
),
activated AS (
  UPDATE ingest_profiles p
  SET is_active = true, updated_at = now()
  FROM upserted u
  WHERE ${setActive ? 'true' : 'false'}
    AND p.profile_id = u.profile_id
    AND p.is_enabled = true
  RETURNING p.*
),
final_profile AS (
  SELECT * FROM activated
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM upserted WHERE NOT ${setActive ? 'true' : 'false'}
),
error_result AS (
  SELECT error_message FROM validated WHERE error_message IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM error_result) THEN false ELSE true END AS ok,
  (SELECT error_message FROM error_result LIMIT 1) AS error,
  (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'profileId', profile_id,
      'profileName', profile_name,
      'avatar', avatar,
      'avatarShort', avatar_short,
      'scene', scene,
      'assetType', asset_type,
      'workflow', workflow,
      'model', model,
      'seed', seed,
      'version', version,
      'autoPromoteLatest', auto_promote_latest,
      'isActive', is_active,
      'isEnabled', is_enabled,
      'createdAt', created_at,
      'updatedAt', updated_at
    )
    FROM final_profile
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS profile;
`;

return { json: { query } };

Avatares AI - Admin - Set Active Ingest Profile

parameters.query:
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_set_active_profile;

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_set_active_profile AS
SELECT
  NULLIF('{{ $json.body.profileId || $json.body.profile_id || "" }}', '')::uuid AS profile_id;

UPDATE ingest_profiles
SET
  is_active = false,
  updated_at = now()
WHERE is_active = true
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM ingest_profiles p
    JOIN tmp_set_active_profile t ON t.profile_id = p.profile_id
    WHERE p.is_enabled = true
  );

UPDATE ingest_profiles p
SET
  is_active = true,
  updated_at = now()
FROM tmp_set_active_profile t
WHERE p.profile_id = t.profile_id
  AND p.is_enabled = true;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM ingest_profiles p
      JOIN tmp_set_active_profile t ON t.profile_id = p.profile_id
      WHERE p.is_enabled = true
        AND p.is_active = true
    )
    THEN true
    ELSE false
  END AS ok,

  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM tmp_set_active_profile
      WHERE profile_id IS NOT NULL
    )
    THEN 'Missing profileId'
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM ingest_profiles p
      JOIN tmp_set_active_profile t ON t.profile_id = p.profile_id
      WHERE p.is_enabled = true
    )
    THEN 'Profile not found or disabled'
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM ingest_profiles p
      JOIN tmp_set_active_profile t ON t.profile_id = p.profile_id
      WHERE p.is_enabled = true
        AND p.is_active = true
    )
    THEN 'Profile could not be activated'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS error,

  (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'profileId', p.profile_id,
      'profileName', p.profile_name,
      'avatar', p.avatar,
      'avatarShort', p.avatar_short,
      'scene', p.scene,
      'assetType', p.asset_type,
      'workflow', p.workflow,
      'model', p.model,
      'seed', p.seed,
      'version', p.version,
      'autoPromoteLatest', p.auto_promote_latest,
      'isActive', p.is_active,
      'isEnabled', p.is_enabled,
      'createdAt', p.created_at,
      'updatedAt', p.updated_at
    )
    FROM ingest_profiles p
    JOIN tmp_set_active_profile t ON t.profile_id = p.profile_id
    WHERE p.is_enabled = true
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS profile;

name: Avatares AI - Promote Canonical Asset - Callable

parameters.query:
WITH selected AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM canonical_asset_registry
  WHERE asset_id = '{{ $json.assetId }}'
  LIMIT 1
), demoted AS (
  UPDATE canonical_asset_registry
  SET
    is_canonical = false,
    status = 'selected',
    metadata = jsonb_set(
      jsonb_set(
        jsonb_set(metadata, '{status}', '"selected"'),
        '{isCanonical}', 'false'
      ),
      '{reviewNotes}', '"Demoted by canonical promotion"'
    )
  WHERE canonical_group = (SELECT canonical_group FROM selected)
    AND is_canonical = true
    AND asset_id <> (SELECT asset_id FROM selected)
  RETURNING asset_id
), promoted AS (
  UPDATE canonical_asset_registry
  SET
    is_canonical = true,
    status = 'canonical',
    review_notes = 'Promoted to canonical',
    metadata = jsonb_set(
      jsonb_set(
        jsonb_set(
          jsonb_set(metadata, '{status}', '"canonical"'),
          '{isCanonical}', 'true'
        ),
        '{reviewNotes}', '"Promoted to canonical"'
      ),
      '{canonicalGroup}', to_jsonb((SELECT canonical_group FROM selected))
    )
  WHERE asset_id = (SELECT asset_id FROM selected)
  RETURNING
    asset_id,
    sha256,
    avatar,
    asset_type,
    scene,
    version,
    bucket,
    object_path,
    original_filename,
    mime_type,
    file_size,
    extension,
    status,
    is_canonical,
    canonical_group,
    metadata,
    created_at
)
SELECT
  promoted.*,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM demoted) AS demoted_count
FROM promoted;

name: Avatares AI - Admin - Delete Ingest Profile

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT NULLIF('{{ String($json.body?.profileId || $json.body?.profile_id || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '') AS profile_id_text
),
target AS (
  SELECT p.*
  FROM ingest_profiles p
  JOIN input i ON p.profile_id::text = i.profile_id_text
  LIMIT 1
),
asset_check AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS asset_count
  FROM canonical_asset_registry a
  JOIN target t
    ON a.avatar = t.avatar
   AND a.scene = t.scene
   AND a.asset_type = t.asset_type
),
deleted AS (
  DELETE FROM ingest_profiles p
  USING target t, asset_check ac
  WHERE p.profile_id = t.profile_id
    AND ac.asset_count = 0
  RETURNING p.*
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT profile_id_text FROM input) IS NULL THEN false
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN false
    WHEN (SELECT asset_count FROM asset_check) > 0 THEN false
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deleted) THEN true
    ELSE false
  END AS ok,

  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT profile_id_text FROM input) IS NULL THEN 'Missing profileId'
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN 'Profile not found'
    WHEN (SELECT asset_count FROM asset_check) > 0 THEN
      'This profile cannot be deleted because assets already exist for it.'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deleted) THEN NULL
    ELSE 'Profile could not be deleted'
  END AS error,

  COALESCE((SELECT asset_count FROM asset_check), 0) AS asset_count,

  (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'profileId', profile_id,
      'profileName', profile_name,
      'avatar', avatar,
      'avatarShort', avatar_short,
      'scene', scene,
      'assetType', asset_type,
      'workflow', workflow,
      'model', model,
      'seed', seed,
      'version', version,
      'autoPromoteLatest', auto_promote_latest,
      'isActive', is_active,
      'isEnabled', is_enabled,
      'createdAt', created_at,
      'updatedAt', updated_at
    )
    FROM target
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS profile,

  (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'profileId', profile_id,
      'profileName', profile_name,
      'avatar', avatar,
      'scene', scene,
      'assetType', asset_type
    )
    FROM deleted
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS deleted_profile;
